observations.summary: A thrown null, undefined or frozen value loses the failureNotWritten mark
observations.recommendation: Scope: instance. In _launchFailed (lib/bridge-gateway.js:958) Object.assign(err, {failureNotWritten: true}) works for an Error and for a thrown string or number (it is boxed and the boxed value is thrown, mark intact). For a thrown null or undefined, or a frozen object, Object.assign itself throws a TypeError that carries no mark, so the caller falls back to what it did before this delta: it ends the launch as launch-error in the same pass. Nothing in the store or node:sqlite throws such a value, and the fallback is the old behaviour, not a wedge or a lost notice. ACCEPT is the default; fixing it moves the tree and costs a round.

Write it where that chunk will meet it (the build plan or `.prawduct/.handoff-notes.md`), or it is not a deferral, it is a drop.
